CoinPackage.title: CoinPackage
CoinPackage.description: Represents a coin package available for purchase in the Cloudverse store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coin package.

name.description: Name of the coin package (e.g., Starter Pack, Value Pack).

coinAmount.description: Amount of coins included in the package.

bonusDescription.description: Description of any bonus included with the package (e.g., 20% bonus coins).

isPopular.description: Indicates if the package is marked as the most popular.

Rank.title: Rank
Rank.description: Represents a rank available for purchase in the Cloudverse store.

name.description: Name of the rank (e.g., Warrior, Champion).

coinBonus.description: Coin bonus given upon purchasing the rank. Can be null.

perks.description: Array of perks included with the rank.

adminKey.description: A secret key to authorize administrative actions.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: Represents a news item displayed on the Cloudverse store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the news item.

adminKey.description: A secret key to authorize administrative actions.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Represents user feedback submitted through the Cloudverse store.

playerName.description: The name of the player submitting the feedback.

rating.description: The rating given by the player (1-5 stars).

message.description: The feedback message entered by the player.

submissionDate.description: The date and time the feedback was submitted.

StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: Represents a staff member displayed on the Cloudverse store.

imageUrl.description: URL of the staff member's profile picture.

rank.description: The staff member's rank (e.g., Admin, Moderator).

roleDescription.description: A brief description of the staff member's role.

adminKey.description: A secret key to authorize administrative actions.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the Cloudverse store's data and access patterns, focusing on simplicity, security, and scalability. Authorization Independence is achieved by avoiding `get()` calls in security rules, ensuring atomic operations. All entities are placed in root-level collections to avoid hierarchical authorization. The structure supports QAPs by ensuring that listing operations can be securely implemented using simple rules based on document existence or equality checks rather than complex filtering.

Specifically:

*   `coin_packages`: Stores coin package information.
*   `ranks`: Stores rank information, write access controlled by `adminKey`.
*   `news_items`: Stores news items for display, write access controlled by `adminKey`.
*   `feedback`: Stores user feedback. No authentication is required to submit feedback, facilitating ease of use.
*   `staff`: Stores staff member information, read access is public, and write access controlled by `adminKey`.

Each collection stores data with homogenous security needs, simplifying the rules. All list operations are safe, as the rules don't rely on filtering data based on user roles or other attributes.
